decisions.reason: The cleaning soap draws directly on the firm's surface-treatment know-how and complements its installed floors, and getting its own page in 2024 suggests the firm is learning from early results and backing it.
The maintenance oil fits the firm's oiled-floor expertise and care range, so the firm can interpret its performance and improve it in-house, even though it only stayed mentioned rather than featured.
The care product for oiled floors builds closely on existing surface-treatment knowledge and was promoted to its own page, signalling successful assimilation and commercial application.

The moisture-protection underlay is a natural accessory to the flooring systems, and the firm's installation and technical guidance capabilities let it judge and refine the product, so keeping it is sensible.

The high-density foam underlay overlaps with product D and relies more on external material knowledge, so the risk of range consolidation is slightly higher, but it still supports the core floor offer.
The oak parquet floor sits at the heart of the firm's long wood-processing know-how and in-house R&D, so it is the product the firm can best evaluate and improve.
